run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the largest subarray with equal number of 0s and 1s
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays and compare results with f_filled
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses nested loops to find subarrays with balanced 0s and 1s
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the size of the largest subarray with equal 0s and 1s
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash map approach for O(n) time complexity instead of O(n^2)
